view_map.Front: shaft elevation; drawing right is +Z, drawing up is +Y

features.rationale: Solid stepped shaft; origin at the left stud end. The apparent reduced region near the right end is formed by flats, not an annular groove.
Mill upper flat at Y = .44 over the dimensioned half-inch axial interval; cutter crosses the entire shaft in X.
features.justification: The elevation shows the flat extending only between the two dimensioned boundaries. The end view locates its plane .44 from the axis; TYP identifies the opposed pair. Cutter width and travel overshoot the circular envelope.

features.rationale: Mill the mirror-image lower flat at Y = -.44, with the same axial boundaries.
features.justification: Opposed flats are shown symmetrically about the shaft centerline and are designated TYP. The sketch and cutter travel extend beyond the OD.

features.rationale: What are the shoulder thread-relief width, root diameter, and transition form? MIN. RELIEF supplies none of these.
features.justification: Nonexecuting zero-width placeholder at the stud shoulder, not an inferred relief profile. Incorporate the resolved relief into F001 stations.

features.rationale: External thread annotation is required on the stud. This IR has no external cosmetic-thread feature; do not replace the stud with a tapped hole or infer helical geometry.
features.justification: Nonexecuting carrier using the nominal stud envelope, not additional material. Retain .750-10 THD. as an external cosmetic annotation; exact thread runout depends on the unresolved end chamfer and relief.

features.rationale: What are the size and angle of the depicted left stud-end chamfer?

features.justification: Zero size and angle are nonexecuting placeholders, not specified chamfer dimensions.

features.rationale: What are the size and angle of the depicted right body-end chamfer?

features.rationale: Stamped text is outside the available profile types; character size, depth, and exact placement also require specification.
features.justification: Nonexecuting zero-size carrier only; no marking geometry or placement is inferred.

notes: Nominal geometry is solid. The end-view inner circle depicts the end chamfer, not a bore.
Dimensions are inches. General tolerances: two-place ±.020; three-place ±.010; angular ±1 degree.
D009–D013 are derived extraction values, not independent manufacturing dimensions; primary printed dimensions drive the planned geometry.
Execute only planned features. Unresolved and unsupported carriers are intentionally nonexecuting and do not define manufacturing geometry.
Preserve the .750-10 THD. external cosmetic callout. Thread standard/class and any additional manufacturing requirements should be confirmed rather than inferred.
